title: Composition-Aware Reduced-Order Modelling of Real-Time Hydrogen Blending in Natural Gas Pipeline Networks: reproduction package
description: Solvers, controller and figure scripts that reproduce every figure, table and number of the accompanying article in the International Journal of Hydrogen Energy. The SciGRID_gas IGGIELGN data set is not redistributed; it is downloaded separately from https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4767098.
